label: Beta cell
note: Endocrine cell within an accepted endocrine object assigned by insulin evidence, with competing lineage evidence reviewed.

label: Alpha cell
note: Endocrine cell within an accepted endocrine object assigned by glucagon evidence.

label: Delta cell
note: Endocrine cell within an accepted endocrine object assigned by somatostatin evidence.

label: CHGA+ hormone-negative
note: Endocrine cell within an accepted endocrine object with chromogranin A evidence and no positive measured hormone.

label: Acinar cell
note: Exocrine epithelial cell supported by epithelial markers and the acinar classification.

label: Ductal cell
note: Exocrine epithelial cell supported by ductal cytokeratin evidence.

label: CD4 Tcell
note: CD4 T-cell subtype. For residual T cells, CD4 and CD8a above-threshold measurements take priority. Below both levels, the subtype is inferred from the marker profile and other donors’ cluster votes.

label: CD8a Tcell
note: CD8a T-cell subtype. For residual T cells, CD4 and CD8a above-threshold measurements take priority. Below both levels, the subtype is inferred from the marker profile and other donors’ cluster votes.

label: B cell
note: B-lineage cell supported by CD20 and the reviewed lineage evidence.

label: Macrophage_LGALS3+
note: Myeloid macrophage with CD68 or CD163 evidence and LGALS3 above the image threshold.

label: Macrophage_LGALS3-
note: Myeloid macrophage with CD68 or CD163 evidence and LGALS3 below or at the image threshold.

label: Stromal
note: Includes mural stromal cells and cells with structural marker evidence only.

label: Fibroblast
note: Fibroblast phenotype supported by mesenchymal marker evidence and the reviewed classifier.

label: Endothelium Blood Vessel
note: Vascular endothelial phenotype supported by vessel-associated marker and spatial evidence.

label: Neural
note: Neural phenotype supported by neural marker and nerve-associated spatial evidence.

label: Endothelium Lymphatic
note: Lymphatic endothelial phenotype supported by marker and lymphatic spatial evidence.

label: Panel undected
note: No typing marker exceeded its assigned threshold. These cells are included in the cohort and excluded from trajectory features.
